entities.name: 黑灯工厂 (dark factory)

entities.how_described: 本集把它说成:2009 年被众人嘲笑「疯了」但最终成功的工程实践,用来类比今天对黑灯工厂的质疑,并预言它将演进为「持续学习」。

evidence.quote: So in 2009, a lot of people were telling me the idea of continuous delivery was crazy.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And for me, that kind of brings continuous delivery actually to continuous learning.

entities.name: 持续学习 (continuous learning)
entities.how_described: 本集把它说成:持续交付的概念升级——把知识不断沉淀进技能、上下文和线束里;终极问题不再是让系统更可靠,而是能否在改动更多部分的同时保持可靠。

evidence.quote: And for me, that kind of brings continuous delivery actually to continuous learning.

entities.name: 铺装路 (paved roads)
entities.how_described: 本集把它说成:类似云时代铺装路的平台注册表内可复用组件(认证系统、linter、安全工具),最终往往是一份三、四条铺装路的目录供团队挑选;自搞一套可以,但走自己的预算。

evidence.quote: Because you won't have paved roads.

evidence.quote: So you probably don't end up with one thing but a catalog of three, four paved roads where they can pick off.
